findings.text: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-domain-consistency-audit.html:232 blocking: the landing record states the mechanism-removed run as "(8 failed, 10 passed, recorded in negative-control.log)", while the log it names records "10 failed, 37 passed, 1 warning" at its line 101 with 47 collected (the audit test file alone accounts for 10 failed and 11 passed) -- no reading of that log yields 8/10, so the record misstates the control the done-when rests on and a reader checking it against the log it cites finds it contradicted.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-domain-consistency-audit.html:23 follow-on: the section says the census ran "at revision f17b64387", but census.log line 2 records revision 9cb3f6c19dafe653c5eda4c0780d0a30dbc23f1b -- the fix commit whose rerun produced the 777 edge count the fragment reports -- so the citation names a tree that did not produce the figures sitting beside it.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-domain-consistency-audit.html:101 follow-on: the edge-count decomposition (984 no-edge names, 746 + 31 = 777) and the absence claim that no edge on the live graph points at a target without an id are not derivable from any recorded artefact -- the results JSON carries only per-check ids and counts, no query log records the no-edge population, and the zero is reported without a check shown to see an id-less target present.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 37bf04533 over f17b64387..9cb3f6c19; four commits, five files, and the last (9cb3f6c19) replaces the edge-set placeholder with an empty set plus an edge_count, corroborated by the pre-fix results JSON reading 1015 edge failures against the post-fix 777.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the gate (test_domain_audit.py plus test_domain_ranking.py and test_domain_selector.py, judged by delta against base) and the census the fragment and results JSON must report; head-gate.log records 47 passed, EXIT=0 and base-gate.log 26 passed, EXIT=0, which is the delta the measure asks for, and census.log records the 2,677 live names with the command first and EXIT=0 last.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is one read-only audit of every live name's domain against its DD sources; imas_codex/standard_names/domain_audit.py:329 (audit_domains) opens a client, runs one bounded label scan over the live stages and returns a count and the failing ids per check, and the four checks at domain_audit.py:285-291 are exactly the goal's four.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; it reports the four commits, the head gate at 47 passed and the census at 2,677 names with 212/1477/1701/777, quotes the three scaffolding failures it fixed, and names negative-control.log's red run at 10 failed -- but the fragment it landed reports that same control as 8 failed and 10 passed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares the module, the test file, three docs/evidence fragments and a docs/figures directory; git diff --name-only 37bf04533 9cb3f6c19 lists exactly the module, the test file and the three fragments and nothing else, and the figures directory is unused.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log line 101 records 10 failures with the four comparisons at domain_audit.py:285-291 removed, so the added assertions redden on that regression; the query at domain_audit.py:100-103 is reachable only through the stub, so reinstating the unknown placeholder would leave every test green.
justifications.evidence: head-gate.log records 47 passed with EXIT=0 against base-gate.log's 26 passed with EXIT=0 and census.log records the live census with EXIT=0, so the measure is recorded rather than claimed; the fragment's own count for the control (its line 232) does not match negative-control.log line 101.
justifications.fit: domain_audit.py follows the sibling imas_codex/standard_names/attachment_audit.py idiom (bounded label scan, per-check dataclass, read-only) and no symbol carries a plan, stage or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: domain_audit.py:285-291 implements the four checks the goal names and the census it produces is the before figure the repair node is to consume.
justifications.reuse: the module reuses the ranking owner (domain_audit.py:42 imports select_primary_domain) instead of re-ranking; searched consolidation.py:_resolve_physics_domains, domain_priority.py, families.py:_LIVE_STAGE_EXCLUSION and edit.py:_FOLD_LIVE_STAGES and found no owner of a DD-source-derived expected domain set.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 37bf04533 9cb3f6c19 returns only the five declared paths, so the diff carries nothing outside the fenced scope.
